summary: End-to-end testing of Atlas Union Summit 2026 cinematic single-page React app + FastAPI backend. All 6 backend pytest tests passed (network stats, access create+persist, access validation, unlock 2526 + 403, passport generation). Frontend testing covered: loading screen first-load behavior + sessionStorage-skip on reload, hero typography & classified labels, sticky navbar with all 6 nav links, access dialog open + submit -> TRANSMISSION RECEIVED, all 7 committee cards, all 6 operation cards, all 5 locked cards with lock icons, cipher unlock 2526 revealing all 5 unlocked-reveal blocks with DECRYPTED label and unique titles, passport generator producing real AUS-XXXX-2026 IDs (e.g. AUS-EYF3-2026) and updating the holographic card live. Network panel confirmed POST /api/unlock 200, POST /api/passport 200, POST /api/access 200, GET /api/network/stats 200.

issues: Framer-motion warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Add position:relative to wrapRef section in Passport.jsx (currently className 'relative' is set so likely a transient warning from useScroll target wrap — non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in modern FastAPI — consider lifespan handler.
Backend has no DELETE/admin endpoint for access_requests cleanup; test data accumulates in MongoDB. Consider adding a cleanup route or TTL index for development environments.
AccessRequest model uses plain str for email instead of EmailStr (EmailStr is imported but not used) — adopt EmailStr for proper validation.
Unlock cipher '2526' is hardcoded in server.py — fine for cinematic demo, but should be moved to env var if reused beyond this event.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 access_requests rows and 2 passports rows during automated testing (prefixed TEST_OPERATOR / Tester Delegate / Playwright Tester)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_atlas_api.py — can be re-run as regression. Frontend has cinematic 7s loading screen on first load; to bypass during automation use page.add_init_script("sessionStorage.setItem('atlas_booted','1')"). Loading skip on reload confirmed working. All data-testid values match /app/frontend/src/constants/testIds.js exactly.
rca of the issue: Initial playwright run reported 'unlocked-reveal did not appear' — this was a test-side timing artifact (only 5s wait_for_selector after click). Re-test with 3s sleep + scroll-into-view confirmed all 5 reveals render correctly and POST /api/unlock returns 200. No app bug. Similarly the first run captured passport-delegate-id as 'AUS-XXXX-2026' (the static placeholder) because the screenshot/read happened just before re-render — re-test confirms real generated ID AUS-EYF3-2026 after API completion.
